name: pred-referral-bot
description: pred.app referral bot with 2Captcha Turnstile solving

scripts.reset: node -e 'const { clearProcessedWallets } = require("./wallet"); const fs = require("fs"); const path = require("path"); clearProcessedWallets(); const envPath = path.join(__dirname, ".env"); if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) { let env = fs.readFileSync(envPath, "utf8"); fs.writeFileSync(envPath, env.replace(/^MNEMONIC=.*/m, "MNEMONIC=")); } console.log("Processed wallets & MNEMONIC di .env berhasil di-reset!");'
